request_text: Make the CI module-test matrix diff-based instead of running all 36 shards on every PR and every push-to-main. Root cause (research-squad confirmed): ci-router.yml is path-scoped but ci-modules.yml/module-tests.yml expand every registry module x shard_count unconditionally. Implementation (design settled): (1) add select_modules(changed_paths, mode) to scripts/ci/gate_selection.py reusing select_gates — the SINGLE authority, no second path->group map; full/unmatched-src -> all 19 modules, else matched groups; (2) ci-modules.yml generate-matrix consults it and skips via JOB-LEVEL if: on the matrix leaf (neutral-skipped check, never include:-filter which reports no check -> pending-forever), keeps -m 'not performance' and pr/full fail-fast semantics, and publishes the selected-module set as an artifact; (3) ci-router.yml: strip 'github.event_name == "push"' from the 22 changes.outputs so push-to-main is diff-based (keep the unmatched fail-closed catch-all); (4) ci-aggregate.yml collect/expected_basenames intersects expected shards with the selected-set artifact so a scoped PR does not fail-closed on 'missing' unchanged-module shards; (5) ci-nightly.yml GAINS a full mode=full module-matrix run as the ~24h cross-module safety net (operator decision, replaces push=full); (6) add a skipped-tolerant terminal gate to ci-modules for required-check repointing; (7) update arch tests (test_gate_selection_authority, test_module_tests_matrix, test_dual_mode_contract, test_ci_router_transcription_guards, ci-aggregate completeness tests, test_performance_marker_guard) and the router-two-authority.md contract. Base: skupstream/main. Motivating tickets #4420 #4429; no existing scoping ticket — file one.
